Trump plans triumphal arch to double as military complex

Donald Trump has stated that a proposed triumphal arch will be converted into a "top grade military complex." According to Trump, this complex would be able to house drones and snipers. He also claimed that the military had made a "strong request" for these changes. The arch is planned to be located near the White House in Washington.
